claims.answer: Root orchestrator coordinates projects; project orchestrator creates goals; goal orchestrator manages beads, planners/scouts, engineers and ephemeral reviewers. Product-defined orchestrator agents decompose goals and use orc dispatch commands to spawn/monitor engineers in worktrees. It is product-owned agent delegation around chosen coding CLIs. Orchestrator tiers route feedback to the relevant goal/engineer; review feedback is written to .worker-feedback and read by the worker. Engineer review signals and reviewer verdicts return to the goal orchestrator, which can request corrective work and later deliver the goal.

sources.finding: Describes local root/project/goal orchestrators, engineers in Git worktrees, Beads tracking, tmux progress and configurable review/delivery. README install URL names thefinalsource/orc but inspected identity is spencermarx/orc.

sources.title: orc docs/agent-clis.md
sources.locator: First-class adapters; Auto-detection; Bring your own CLI
sources.finding: Exact adapter table specifies Claude Code append-system-prompt/permission flags, OpenCode agent configuration, Codex AGENTS.md/bypass flags and Gemini GEMINI.md/yolo. Per-project agent_cmd permits different CLI choices.

sources.title: orc docs/concepts.md
sources.finding: Product-defined orchestrator roles decompose work, dispatch workers and track results, with Beads as its retained state.

sources.title: orc docs/review.md
sources.locator: Dev review; Goal review; Addressing feedback
sources.finding: Reviewer panes write a verdict/feedback file. Approved beads fast-forward to goal; failed review returns to engineer. Goal review is optional and interpreted by the orchestrator, not a typed hard permission boundary.

sources.title: orc docs/delivery.md
sources.locator: Two modes; User involvement; Ticket integration
sources.finding: Default delivery presents local branch. Configured natural-language hook may git push/gh pr create and update tickets when tools exist. Human delivery pause can be disabled; this is not independently verified server authority enforcement.
